fusions.name: Headsman's Plummet
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Dives onto it from up to 8 tiles away for 22 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the full 8 tiles.

fusions.name: Shearing Pass
fusions.desc: Sweeps past in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Climb Before the Drop
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Keen Leading Edge
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your dodge chance rises by 5%.
